description: Calculate the exact total cost and recommended package for an event based on duration in days, currency (ZAR or USD), and optional extra day extensions. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'calculate_event_cost' on GuestDrop Event Photo Album (guestdropalbum.com). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_pricing_and_packages' or 'recommend_scavenger_quests' or 'create_event_checkout' for their respective operations). Parameters: duration_days (required), currency (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

currency.description: Currency to quote in (ZAR or USD). Defaults to ZAR.

duration_days.description: Total duration of the event in days (e.g. 1 for a single-day wedding, 3 for a wedding weekend, 7 for a destination trip). [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].
